$comment: pricing-v2 (leaders.ke-pricing-v2.csv): one flat rate per tier, every office costs the same. Prices in KES; annual = 10 x monthly (2 months free). Caps: null = unlimited. creditsPerMonth funds metered broadcast sends (SMS = 1 credit, WhatsApp = 5 credits). knowledgeMb caps total Knowledge-tab text (docs/ai-chat-costs.md). analytics/prAiAgent/voterHeatmap/sentimentSuite/newsSourceControl are on/off perks shown as ✓/- on /pricing; perkLabels below is their single-source-of-truth display text, read by /pricing, /dashboard/admin/packages, and $lib/server/packages.ts alike. perkLabels/perkTooltips/capTooltips are the single source of that wording: the pricing table and the admin Packages page both read them.

perkLabels.prAiAgent: PR AI Agent for daily news research & response drafts
perkLabels.newsSourceControl: Control your news: filter platforms that can tag you in news to avoid biased reporting
perkLabels.sentimentSuite: Sentiment Intelligence Suite: distinguish media coverage that is helping vs hurting your campaign and that of your rivals
perkLabels.voterHeatmap: Voter heatmap per ward: see where the numbers can tilt the outcome of the vote.

perkTooltips.analytics: Page views, where visitors came from, and which of them became followers or vote pledges, on your dashboard.
perkTooltips.prAiAgent: Every article that names you, gathered daily from Google News and Kenyan outlets, with its tone classified and a draft response you can edit and publish.
perkTooltips.newsSourceControl: Choose which outlets may tag you. An article from a source you exclude never reaches your profile or your press desk.
perkTooltips.sentimentSuite: Positive, neutral and negative coverage counted over time, for you and for everyone else contesting your seat.
perkTooltips.voterHeatmap: Registered voters and your support ward by ward, so you can see which wards decide the seat and which are still open.

capTooltips.managers: Each manager runs your dashboard alongside you: publish news, reply to citizens, edit your manifesto and see every follower. Admin managers can also add or remove team members.
capTooltips.ambassadors: Each ambassador recruits followers to your campaign. They cannot see each other's lists but managers can see all followers.
capTooltips.subscriptions: Citizens who can follow this page and receive your broadcasts.
capTooltips.creditsPerMonth: Spent on broadcasts (SMS, WhatsApp, email) and on AI answers to citizens who ask questions on your page.
